newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Sorin Q1 1997 pre-tax slips.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Sorin Q1 1997 pre-tax slips.

text.p: Sorin Biomedica SpA, part of the Fiat group, said it posted first quarter 1997 group pre-tax profit of 15.4 billion lire, down from some 22 billion in the same 1996 period.
The bio-medical technology group said in a statement that first quarter gross turnover was around 200 billion lire against some 223 billion in the same period last year.
First quarter operating profit slipped to 19 billion lire from 25 billion due to unfavourable exchange rates, it said.

The statement, issued after a shareholder's meeting to approve 1996 results, confirmed the group posted 1996 net profit of 70.8 billion lire against 44.3 billion in 1995 on turnover of 858 billion lire against 893 billion.
Parent company net profit was 20.4 billion lire in 1996 against 39.7 billion with a dividend of 200 lire per share against 180 lire for 1995.
The company, which is directly controlled by Fiat's Snia Bpd, said it aimed to complete the sale of its immuno-diagnostic activities by the end of June for a capital gain of around 120 billion lire.
